title: Compatible injective embeddings of étale coefficient systems
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves on the small étale site of $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For $f:i\to j$ write $u_f=D(f^{\mathrm{op}}):D_j\to D_i$, and suppose given $\varphi_f:u_f^{-1}F_i\to F_j$, where inverse image is as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume $\varphi_{\mathrm{id}}$ is the canonical inverse-image identity comparison, including transport along $D(\mathrm{id})=\mathrm{id}$. Assume $\varphi_{g\circ f}=\varphi_g\circ u_g^{-1}(\varphi_f)\circ c_{u_g,u_f}$, with transport along $D(g\circ f)=u_f\circ u_g$, where $c$ identifies inverse image along a composite with iterated inverse image. There exist sheaves $A_i$, transitions $\psi_f:u_f^{-1}A_i\to A_j$ satisfying the same identity and composition laws, and monomorphisms $a_i:F_i\to A_i$ with every $A_i$ injective, such that $a_j\circ\varphi_f=\psi_f\circ u_f^{-1}(a_i)$. Injective means every map into the object extends across every monomorphism. No cokernel, cone-point functor or exact diagram is asserted.

theorem etale_coefficient_injective_system
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
 :
    ∃ (FI : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FI i) ⟶ FI j)
    (hidentityI : ∀ i : I, ψ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FI i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FI i))
    (hcompositionI : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      ψ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FI i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (ψ f) ≫ ψ g)
    (ai : ∀ i : I, F i ⟶ FI i),
      (∀ i : I, Injective (FI i)) ∧ (∀ i : I, Mono (ai i)) ∧
      (∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
        φ f ≫ ai j = (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).map (ai i) ≫ ψ f)
